description: (0.5.0) Verdict determinism and the sealable as-of digest (RFC-ACDP-0017 §9.2, §9.3).

expected.behavior: Two independent implementations, given identical roots, bundle bytes and options, emit byte-identical JCS verdicts: equal verdict_digest and as_of_digest.
verify_chain over a bundle collected online, and verify_chain_online over the same registry state, give the same verdict_digest.
Add a lifecycle event with accepted_at > T and a DID snapshot observed after T: verdict_digest and evidence_digest change; as_of_digest does NOT.

scenarios.name: D — evidence added at or before T

expected.behavior: Add a discovery record with completed_at <= T that changes a stage: as_of_digest changes — the auditor learns the bundles differ in evidence dated <= T.

expected.non_conformant_implementation: Adding diagnostics (durations, fetch logs) or null-valued optional members to the verdict object; both break byte identity.

expected.behavior: A fired time budget sets control timeout and complete false; such a verdict is exempt from A–B.

notes: Behavioral in this Draft: the verifier builds the described bundle from real signed bodies (or the rcpt-001 / sig-003 test keys), runs verify_chain, and asserts the pinned stage values and verdicts. Pinned verdict digests replace these assertions at promotion (RFC-ACDP-0017 §14).
